items.title: Is General Mills (GIS) Reasonable for Value Investors Today?
items.summary: General Mills stock has had a weak run over the past few years, while current valuation checks suggest the shares are neither a clear bargain nor obviously overpriced at today’s level. For investors, the interest lies in how that mixed signal lines up with the company’s long term appeal as a consumer staples business. items.title: General Mills (GIS) Seeks Bylaw Changes On Officer Liability
items.summary: General Mills (NYSE: GIS) has put forward a proposal to amend its bylaws to address officer exculpation and a federal forum selection provision at its upcoming shareholder meeting. The changes would provide certain officers with protection from monetary liability for specific fiduciary duty claims consistent with recent corporate law developments.
